topic: Skechers box calibration and model skipping
summary_markdown: Someone updated the calibration for the "JCD_UK_TRN_Skechers" box (ID 4351) to 74 (compared to 78 for other UK boxes). The model for this specific box is temporarily skipped until the team returns from vacation, at which point a decision will be made.
decisions: The calibration for the "JCD_UK_TRN_Skechers" box was set to 74.
